claims.statement: main.tsx installs a vite:preloadError handler that reloads once via window.location.reload(), gated by a sessionStorage chunk-reload guard to prevent loops; registerSW({immediate: true}) uses vite-plugin-pwa Workbox registration in autoUpdate mode so a new SW takes control and reloads an open tab after deploy.

App.tsx re-mounts the entire application subtree whenever manifest.authority_generation changes by setting key={manifest.authority_generation} on ReadyRecruitmentApplication; ensureRuntimeGeneration(authorityGeneration) closes the realtime socket, increments runtimeEpoch, clears the query/mutation caches, tears down the ra-core store, and clears LEGACY_ADAPTER_KEYS from localStorage.

RuntimeGenerationBundle is keyed by getStaticRecruitmentRuntimeKey(authorityGeneration) = recruitment:${authorityGeneration}; the store key is derived from an FNV-1a hash and exposed as CRM:<hex>; the QueryClient uses offlineFirst network mode with 30 s staleTime and 24 h gcTime.
Runtime epoch (getRuntimeEpoch / isRuntimeEpochCurrent) is bound into the conversation runtime via bindConversationRuntimeEpoch so async conversation work aborts itself when the generation moves.

canAccess(role, params, availableResources) is a UX-only mirror of the backend RBAC; the file's own comment declares real enforcement is the FastAPI backend (app/api/dependencies.py), so the console never relies on the client gate to keep secrets off-screen.
The vite-plugin-pwa Workbox config has cleanupOutdatedCaches: true and explicit globIgnores for favicons, logos, the Zalo verifier HTML, and the auth callback so those are never pre-cached.
